storytelling: The danger lies in forgetting what we had. Or there is a shared daily life riddled with holes of silence.

Till it fell,
Yet that Whip's Name
Too noble then to tell.
Magnanimous as Bird
By Boy descried –
Singing unto the Stone
Of which it died –
Shame need not crouch
In such an Earth as Ours –
Shame – stand erect –
The Universe is yours.
